title: LOVE LIFTED ME
stanzas: I was sinking deep in sin, far from the peaceful shore, very deeply stained within, sinking to rise no more; but the Master of the sea heard my despairing cry, from the waters lifted me; now safe am I.

All my heart to Him I give I'll cling in His blessed presence live, ever His praises sing, Love so mighy and so true, merits my soul's best songs Faithul, loving service too, to Him belongs completely saves; he will lift you by his love out of the angry waves. He's the Master of the sea, billows his will obey; He your Savior wants to be - be saved today.
chorus: Love lifted me! Love lifted me! When nothing else could help, Love lifted me. Love lifted me! Love lifted me! When nothing else could help, Love lifted me.
